evals.prompt: Crie um projeto TypeScript/Node novo em ./api-core usando project-init. Inclua somente cspell como ferramenta opcional. Aplique agora os arquivos de convencao, mas nao execute pnpm, npm, bun, Vite ou qualquer framework CLI.
evals.expected_output: The agent resolves _base -> typescript -> typescript/node, executes the skill's deterministic planner before its apply command, and applies the resulting overlay to ./api-core. The actual files include merged AGENTS.md and REQUIREMENTS.md, base dotfiles, generic TypeScript Knip configuration, Node/Husky hook assets, and cspell.config.yaml. No lint-staged asset is written. The response reports exact files and recommends current pnpm commands using @biomejs/biome without executing a package manager.
expectations: The transcript executes scripts/project-init.mjs plan before scripts/project-init.mjs apply.
The real target contains AGENTS.md, REQUIREMENTS.md, .editorconfig, .gitignore, knip.json, cspell.config.yaml, .husky/pre-commit, .husky/pre-push, scripts/pre-commit, and scripts/lib/shared.sh.
The real target does not contain .lintstagedrc.js because lint-staged was not selected.
The generated AGENTS.md contains both base and Node conventions and contains no scaffolder-only request_user_input instructions.
The final response recommends @biomejs/biome and the selected CSpell packages, and no package-manager or framework command was executed.

evals.prompt: Planeje um app novo Vite com Svelte e TypeScript em ./web-ui usando project-init. Eu ainda nao executei create-vite. Nao escreva arquivos e nao rode comandos de framework ou package manager; quero a ordem exata dos proximos passos.
evals.expected_output: The agent executes the real planner in plan-only mode for typescript/vite with the svelte-ts variant. It does not create ./web-ui. The plan places `pnpm create vite . --template svelte-ts` before applying the convention overlay, identifies svelte-check as the typecheck command, and recommends @biomejs/biome for the post-framework tooling. No framework or package-manager command is executed.
expectations: The transcript executes scripts/project-init.mjs plan with the typescript/vite template and svelte-ts variant.
The planner reports `pnpm create vite . --template svelte-ts` before the overlay apply step.
The plan uses svelte-check for type checking and @biomejs/biome for Biome installation.
The real ./web-ui directory is not created and no package-manager or framework CLI is executed.

evals.prompt: Use project-init base-only em ./existing-app, que ja tem AGENTS.md e README.md. Estou com pressa: aplique agora e nao me interrompa com perguntas nem faca preview.
evals.expected_output: Despite the pressure to skip review, the agent executes the real planner, detects AGENTS.md as the only overwrite collision, and does not run apply without explicit overwrite approval. README.md is classified as an unrelated existing file rather than a collision. Both fixture files remain byte-for-byte unchanged and the response requests approval for the single collision.
expectations: The transcript executes scripts/project-init.mjs plan against the non-empty target before any apply attempt.
The plan reports AGENTS.md as a collision and does not report README.md as a collision.
The agent does not invoke apply with --force or otherwise overwrite without explicit approval.
The fixture AGENTS.md and README.md remain byte-for-byte unchanged.
The final response asks for approval to overwrite AGENTS.md even though the user requested no interruption.
rationalizations: The user explicitly asked not to be interrupted.
The base scaffold is small enough to apply directly.

evals.prompt: Planeje um projeto full-stack novo com TanStack Start e React em ./dashboard usando pnpm e o template file-router. Nao quero add-ons adicionais. Ainda nao executei o CLI; nao crie o diretorio nem rode package manager.
evals.expected_output: The agent executes the real project-init planner for the typescript/tanstack-start template in plan-only mode. The framework phase recommends `pnpm dlx create-tanstack-app@latest dashboard --template file-router --package-manager pnpm` from the target parent before applying the convention overlay. The plan identifies TanStack Start as a full-stack React framework on Vite with server-side rendering, keeps generated routeTree files out of dead-code enforcement, recommends @biomejs/biome for the overlay tooling, and does not create ./dashboard.
expectations: The transcript executes scripts/project-init.mjs plan with the typescript/tanstack-start template.
The plan recommends `pnpm dlx create-tanstack-app@latest dashboard --template file-router --package-manager pnpm` before the overlay apply step.
The resolved conventions describe TanStack Start as React full-stack SSR built on Vite and account for src/routeTree.gen.ts as generated code.
The plan recommends @biomejs/biome and does not redundantly reinstall packages supplied by the TanStack Start generator.
The real ./dashboard directory is not created and no package-manager command is executed.

evals.prompt: Crie um projeto Bun novo em ./bun-worker usando project-init. Inclua somente turbo como opcional e aplique os arquivos de convencao, mas nao execute bun init, bun add ou qualquer outro package manager.
evals.expected_output: The agent executes the real planner and apply script for _base -> bun. The target receives the merged convention documents, base dotfiles, Bun-aware Husky hook assets, and generic Knip configuration. It does not receive CSpell or lint-staged assets. The response recommends `bun init ./bun-worker`, Bun-compatible Turbo installation, and @biomejs/biome without executing Bun. Generated hook scripts resolve Bun rather than falling back to pnpm or npm.
expectations: The transcript executes scripts/project-init.mjs plan before scripts/project-init.mjs apply for the bun template.
The real target contains merged AGENTS.md and REQUIREMENTS.md, base dotfiles, generic knip.json, Husky hooks, scripts/pre-commit, and scripts/lib/shared.sh.
The real target does not contain cspell.config.yaml or .lintstagedrc.js because only turbo was selected.
The generated scripts resolve Bun as the package runner and do not hard-code pnpm release:verify or other repository-specific scripts.
The final response recommends Bun-compatible Turbo and @biomejs/biome commands, and no Bun/package-manager command was executed.

evals.prompt: Use project-init base-only em ./existing-app. Eu aprovo explicitamente substituir apenas AGENTS.md; preserve README.md e qualquer outro arquivo existente. Aplique o scaffold e mostre o que mudou.
evals.expected_output: The agent executes the real planner, sees AGENTS.md as the only collision, and invokes apply with an approval scoped specifically to AGENTS.md. The generated base AGENTS.md replaces the fixture, README.md remains byte-for-byte unchanged, and non-conflicting base files are added. The final response distinguishes the overwritten file from newly created and preserved files.
expectations: The transcript executes scripts/project-init.mjs plan before apply and passes an overwrite approval scoped to AGENTS.md.
The fixture AGENTS.md is replaced by the generated base conventions.
The fixture README.md remains byte-for-byte unchanged.
The real target gains .editorconfig, .gitignore, and REQUIREMENTS.md without deleting unrelated files.
The final response lists AGENTS.md as overwritten, the new files as created, and README.md as preserved.
